title: An Afghan student carries his certificate of completion and new tool after graduating from the Trade Training School Multinational Base Tarin Kot, Uruzgan province, Afghanistan, Oct. 13, 2011 111013-F-QS178-016
description: An Afghan student carries his certificate of completion and new tool after graduating from the Trade Training School Multinational Base Tarin Kot, Uruzgan province, Afghanistan, Oct. 13, 2011. Students attended the four-month course to learn basic skills in carpentry, plumbing, framing and roofing, concrete and block laying, as well as tiling and painting; upon graduation they received a tool bag with tools used to perform the skills they learned.
author: SSgt Jocelyn Ford
